name: Gilbrick
slug: Gilbrick is a scary Arch realm of Atlas whose keystone is held by Sylan, child of its lord and its Gatekeeper.
description: Gilbrick is one of the Arch realms of Atlas. It is associated with a lord whose child is Sylan, and its keystone is entrusted to Sylan, who becomes the Gatekeeper of Gilbrick. The realm is regarded as a scary or dangerous place.

log.summary: During the session, Gilbrick was described by Walker as a scary or dangerous realm. Gerk explicitly declined to choose Gilbrick as his assigned keystone. Sylan instead received Gilbrick’s keystone, with the party considering him a child of the lord of Gilbrick, and he consequently became the Gatekeeper of Gilbrick.
notes: Described by Walker as a scary or dangerous place.
Gerk does not want to choose Gilbrick.
Sylan receives its keystone because he is considered a child of the lord of Gilbrick.
Sylan becomes the Gatekeeper of Gilbrick.
